findings.evidence: `rg -n "Null-homology is preserved|theorem IsNullHomologous.const_mul" TauCeti/Analysis/Contour/WindingNumberScale.lean` shows the doc at lines 33-34 omits the condition while the declaration at lines 122-124 includes `(hpv : ∀ z ∉ Ω, CauchyPVExistsAt γ a b κ[z] z)`.
findings.fix: Revise the module docstring/main-results bullet to say null-homology is preserved only with the pointwise `CauchyPVExistsAt` hypothesis, or in the separate avoided-pole wrapper.
findings.issue: The module docstring says simultaneous nonzero scaling makes “the winding number and null-homology invariant” and later lists `IsNullHomologous.const_mul` without its extra hypothesis, but the null-homology theorem is not unconditional.

summary: The declarations are documented, but the module docstring overstates the null-homology result by presenting scaling invariance as unconditional.
